mentions.name: SciCrumb
mentions.description: SciCrumb is a mobile app that makes scientific research accessible by serving one curated paper a day, simplified into a 3-minute read so curious readers can pick up new ideas and knowledge daily.
mentions.problem: Most people never hear about scientific discoveries that could change how they think, eat, train, sleep, and work, because papers are dense, paywalled, and written for specialists.
mentions.audience: Curious minds who want to learn from scientific discoveries without wading through academic papers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built SciCrumb to fix that. One paper a day, simplified to 3 minutes. I curate what's actually worth your time.

evidence.value: I built SciCrumb to fix that. One paper a day, simplified to 3 minutes. I curate what's actually worth your time.
